title: Merge Sort
definition: Merge Sort divides the array into smaller parts, sorts them, and merges them back together.
realLifeExample: It is like dividing a pile of papers into small sorted piles and then combining them in order.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Treat each element as a sorted run.
2. Merge adjacent runs repeatedly.
3. Double the run size after each pass.
4. Stop when one full sorted run remains.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Split the array into halves.
2. Recursively sort each half.
3. Merge the sorted halves.
4. Return the merged result.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. If the array has one element, return.
2. Divide it into left and right halves.
3. Recursively sort both halves.
4. Merge them into sorted order.
